train_matching_network: train a matching network model for one-shot learning using an HDF5 feature file and base classes
run_test: run evaluation of a trained matching network on test data and report top-1 and top-5 accuracy
encode_lowshot_trainset: encode a low-shot training set with base and novel class features for few-shot classification
MatchingNetwork_forward: run a matching network forward pass to compute log probabilities for query features against a support set
FullyContextualEmbedding_forward: compute fully contextual embeddings using attention-weighted LSTM over support set features
